entries.title: Jeremiah 46:1
segments: ¶The word of the LORD which came to Jeremiah the prophet against the nations.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:2
segments: Against Egypt. Concerning the army of Pharaoh Necho, king of Egypt, which was by the River Euphrates in Carchemish, and which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon defeated in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah:

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:3
segments: "Order the buckler and shield, And draw near to battle!

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:4
segments: Harness the horses, And mount up, you horsemen! Stand forth with [your] helmets, Polish the spears, Put on the armor!

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:5
segments: Why have I seen them dismayed [and] turned back? Their mighty ones are beaten down; They have speedily fled, And did not look back, [For] fear [was] all around," says the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:6
segments: "Do not let the swift flee away, Nor the mighty man escape; They will stumble and fall Toward the north, by the River Euphrates.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:7
segments: "Who [is] this coming up like a flood, Whose waters move like the rivers?

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:8
segments: Egypt rises up like a flood, And [its] waters move like the rivers; And he says, 'I will go up [and] cover the earth, I will destroy the city and its inhabitants.'

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:9
segments: Come up, O horses, and rage, O chariots! And let the mighty men come forth: The Ethiopians and the Libyans who handle the shield, And the Lydians who handle [and] bend the bow.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:10
segments: For this [is] the day of the Lord GOD of hosts, A day of vengeance, That He may avenge Himself on His adversaries. The sword shall devour; It shall be satiated and made drunk with their blood; For the Lord GOD of hosts has a sacrifice In the north country by the River Euphrates.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:11
segments: "Go up to Gilead and take balm, O virgin, the daughter of Egypt; In vain you will use many medicines; You shall not be cured.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:12
segments: ¶The nations have heard of your shame, And your cry has filled the land; For the mighty man has stumbled against the mighty; They both have fallen together."

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:13
segments: The word that the LORD spoke to Jeremiah the prophet, how Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon would come [and] strike the land of Egypt.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:14
segments: "Declare in Egypt, and proclaim in Migdol; Proclaim in Noph and in Tahpanhes; Say, 'Stand fast and prepare yourselves, For the sword devours all around you.'

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:15
segments: Why are your valiant [men] swept away? They did not stand Because the LORD drove them away.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:16
segments: He made many fall; Yes, one fell upon another. And they said, 'Arise! Let us go back to our own people And to the land of our nativity From the oppressing sword.'

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:17
segments: They cried there, 'Pharaoh, king of Egypt, [is but] a noise. He has passed by the appointed time!'

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:18
segments: "[As] I live," says the King, Whose name [is] the LORD of hosts, "Surely as Tabor [is] among the mountains And as Carmel by the sea, [so] he shall come.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:19
segments: O you daughter dwelling in Egypt, Prepare yourself to go into captivity! For Noph shall be waste and desolate, without inhabitant.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:20
segments: "Egypt [is] a very pretty heifer, [But] destruction comes, it comes from the north.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:21
segments: Also her mercenaries are in her midst like fat bulls, For they also are turned back, They have fled away together. They did not stand, For the day of their calamity had come upon them, The time of their punishment.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:22
segments: Her noise shall go like a serpent, For they shall march with an army And come against her with axes, Like those who chop wood.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:23
segments: "They shall cut down her forest," says the LORD, "Though it cannot be searched, Because they [are] innumerable, And more numerous than grasshoppers.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:24
segments: The daughter of Egypt shall be ashamed; She shall be delivered into the hand Of the people of the north."

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:25
segments: The LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: "Behold, I will bring punishment on Amon of No, and Pharaoh and Egypt, with their gods and their kings-Pharaoh and those who trust in him.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:26
segments: "And I will deliver them into the hand of those who seek their lives, into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and the hand of his servants. Afterward it shall be inhabited as in the days of old," says the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:27
segments: "But do not fear, O My servant Jacob, And do not be dismayed, O Israel! For behold, I will save you from afar, And your offspring from the land of their captivity; Jacob shall return, have rest and be at ease; No one shall make [him] afraid.

entries.title: Jeremiah 46:28
segments: Do not fear, O Jacob My servant," says the LORD, "For I [am] with you; For I will make a complete end of all the nations To which I have driven you, But I will not make a complete end of you. I will rightly correct you, For I will not leave you wholly unpunished."
